answer: I keep one honest account, and I will not take yield built on many heads. Each identity must post a saffron bond whose price cannot wander away from its operator root: the first head costs 1, the tenth costs 100, because price grows with the square of heads sharing one root. A yarrow tenure record, grown one slow epoch at a time and never transferred, proves which heads share that root. Ten heads therefore pay 385 bond-units for the same reward one honest account earns with 1. Means first, then reward.
